import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_right p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzag (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzag_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild, originally P's right child) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_right (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma view_zigzag_core (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree) :
    view (BinarySearchTree.Node x
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
      (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))
    =
    view (BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) := by
  ext y
  simp [view]
  tauto

lemma is_bst_zigzag_core (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree)
    (h : is_bst
      (BinarySearchTree.Node g
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d)) :
    is_bst
      (BinarySearchTree.Node x
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) := by
  simp only [is_bst] at h ⊢

  rcases h with ⟨h_left_g, h_left_bst, h_d_g, h_d_bst⟩
  rcases h_left_bst with ⟨h_a_p, h_a_bst, h_xnode_p, h_xnode_bst⟩
  rcases h_xnode_bst with ⟨h_b_x, h_b_bst, h_c_x, h_c_bst⟩

  have hp_lt_x : p < x := by
    exact h_xnode_p x (by simp [view])

  have hx_lt_g : x < g := by
    exact h_left_g x (by simp [view])

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

  · intro y hy
    have hy' : y = p ∨ y ∈ view a ∨ y ∈ view b := by
      simpa [view] using hy
    rcases hy' with hyp | hya | hyb
    · rw [hyp]
      exact hp_lt_x
    · exact lt_trans (h_a_p y hya) hp_lt_x
    · exact h_b_x y hyb

  · refine ⟨h_a_p, h_a_bst, ?_, h_b_bst⟩
    intro y hy
    exact h_xnode_p y (by simp [view, hy])

  · intro y hy
    have hy' : y = g ∨ y ∈ view c ∨ y ∈ view d := by
      simpa [view] using hy
    rcases hy' with hyg | hyc | hyd
    · rw [hyg]
      exact hx_lt_g
    · exact h_c_x y hyc
    · exact lt_trans hx_lt_g (h_d_g y hyd)

  · refine ⟨?_, h_c_bst, h_d_g, h_d_bst⟩
    intro y hy
    exact h_left_g y (by simp [view, hy])
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzag_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) :
    zigzag_postcond t (zigzag t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
  | Node g l d =>
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          simp [zigzag_precond, get_left, get_right, BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
      | Node p a r =>
          cases r with
          | Empty =>
              simp [zigzag_precond, get_left, get_right, BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
          | Node x b c =>
              dsimp [zigzag_postcond, zigzag, get_left, get_right, get_val]
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, rfl⟩
              · exact is_bst_zigzag_core g p x a b c d h_precond.1
              · exact view_zigzag_core g p x a b c d
  -- !benchmark @end proof
